notes: Non-TFQ baselines in this script are in-house approximations: GPTQ-LDLQ has no act-order and fixes min/max group scales before error feedback; Scalar Lloyd-Max + LDLQ uses a 1D optimal Gaussian grid after 2D-FWHT (not EXL3's trellis codebook).
delta_nll_vs_bf16 and delta_nll_ci95 are paired per-sequence NLL differences (method - BF16) bootstrapped over the identical evaluation sequences.
